ana.heat.page.title: Disbursement heat-map
ana.heat.page.subtitle: Units against fund sources, contractors against units or fund sources: each cell says its rate as a number, a word and a mark, never by colour alone.
ana.heat.view.aria: Choose the view of the heat-map
ana.heat.view.label: View
ana.heat.na.small: Too few projects or contracts, so it is not shown.
ana.heat.na.noSnapshot: There is no frozen snapshot yet.
ana.heat.na.notCertified: The definition of the disbursement rate is not certified, so the map is not shown.
ana.heat.na.other: It cannot be computed because data is missing.
ana.heat.legend.unit: Coloured by the rate of disbursement against the pace of the year: good from {green} times, watch from {amber} times, below that slow.
ana.heat.legend.contractor: Coloured by the percent paid of the accepted work: good from {green}%, watch from {amber}%, below that slow.
ana.heat.legend.min: A cell under {count} projects or contracts is not shown.
ana.heat.hidden: {count} cells are not shown because they are too small; the totals of a row and a column leave them out.
ana.heat.table.caption: Each row is one kind of thing, each column another; each cell has its rate, its colour as a word and a mark, and what it is made of
ana.heat.total.note: A total is the rate of the sum of the cells shown, not the average of the rates.
ana.heat.link.backtest: Back-test of the thresholds and the trend
ana.back.page.title: Back-test of the thresholds and the trend
ana.back.page.subtitle: A replay of the stored weeks of the early-warning score against what happened after, for each candidate threshold; and the ranking of units by the change of the score.
ana.back.context.unit: Unit: points out of 100 and weeks
ana.back.denied: You may not see the back-test of the thresholds.
ana.back.error: The back-test could not be read.
ana.back.report.title: Report of the back-test
ana.back.caveat: This is a replay of the past, not a promise about the future, and it changes no threshold in force: a change goes through the governance rules.
ana.back.summary: {pairs} pairs of unit and week of {units} units over {weeks} weeks; {positives} pairs were followed by a red week in the next {horizon} weeks.
ana.back.lines: Thresholds in force: amber from {amber} points, red from {red}.
ana.back.table.caption: Each row is a candidate threshold with the warnings that were right, wrong, missed, its precision, recall and lead time
ana.back.chart.title: Precision and recall by threshold
ana.back.chart.caption: Chart of the precision and the recall of the thresholds that start from the amber line
ana.back.na.tooFew: Not enough pairs of unit and week to compute.
ana.back.na.noPositive: This threshold never warns, so it has no precision.
ana.back.na.noOutcome: No unit went red inside the horizon, so there is no recall.
ana.back.na.noSnapshot: There is no frozen snapshot yet.
ana.back.na.noScoreNow: The latest week has no score.
ana.back.na.noScoreBefore: The week to compare with has no score.
ana.back.na.other: It cannot be computed because data is missing.
ana.back.trend.title: Ranking by trend
ana.back.trend.caveat: This is the change of the early-warning score (a low score is good), not its level.
ana.back.trend.error: The trend ranking could not be read.
ana.back.trend.sparkline: Scores of the weeks of unit {unit}
